titulo: Anthropic revenue jumps 46% to $16.8bn as AI firm eyes record $2 trillion IPO valuation
cuerpo: AI developer Anthropic grew its sales by about 46% to $16.8 billion (€15bn) last quarter and turned an adjusted profit, it told investors on Wednesday, weeks before a November stock market debut that could value it at up to $2 trillion (€1.79bn).
